args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The three earlier parties never left Manufactory Nine because they are caught in a time loop that lasts slightly under an hour [2]. When the loop ends, it starts again, and anyone inside who cannot "feel" the loop forgets the entire turn and is reset to the threshold [2]. Consequently, these individuals are not dead, but are instead "still walking in" every hour, repeating the same turn for nine years [2].

The mechanism of this phenomenon is as follows:
*   **The Cause:** The Lumen Concern was digging for lumen when they struck "the Whole," which caused space to fold and time to catch [5].
*   **The Effect:** This created a "Fold" where space is bent back on itself, making the interior of the building larger than the exterior [4]. Because of this, the building collapsed during the first turn of the loop and has been "coming down every turn since" [5].
*   **The Reset:** Every time the hour turns, the room resets [3]. Those who cannot "hold the deep Facets back" are reset to the top of the stairs, losing their memory of the previous turn [7].

Odeline Marran is able to remember every turn because she is one of the few who can "feel" the loop [2]. While others are reset, she has been living the same hour for nine years [6].
